description: This file defines a utility module for aligning subtitle cues to a reference transcript based on text similarity and timing heuristics. It includes normalization, tokenization, similarity calculation, greedy greedy monotonic alignment, overlap correction, and a public function `align_subtitles_to_transcript` that processes raw transcript and subtitle data to produce synchronized subtitle timings, suitable for scripts or REPL use.

methods.name: str _normalize_text(s: str)
methods.description: Lowercases the string, removes punctuation (except apostrophes), and squeezes whitespace.

methods.name: List[str] _tokens(s: str)
methods.description: Tokenizes and normalizes text into a list of tokens.

methods.name: float _jaccard(a_tokens: List[str], b_tokens: List[str])
methods.description: Computes the Jaccard similarity between two token lists.

methods.name: float _safe_float(v, default=0.0)
methods.description: Safely converts a value to float, returning a default on failure.

methods.name: List[Dict] _sort_by_start(items: List[Dict])
methods.description: Sorts subtitle or transcript items by their start time, coercing non-dict entries into dicts.

methods.name: float _duration(item: Dict)
methods.description: Calculates duration (end - start) of an item.

methods.name: str _merge_texts(items: List[Dict])
methods.description: Concatenates text fields from multiple items into a single string.

methods.name: Tuple[float,float] _span_time(items: List[Dict])
methods.description: Returns the start of the first and end of the last item in a segment list.

methods.name: float _clip(val: float, lo: float, hi: float)
methods.description: Clamps a value between lo and hi.

methods.name: Optional[logging.Logger] _get_logger(verbose: bool, logger: Optional[logging.Logger])
methods.description: Provides a logging.Logger instance based on verbose flag or provided logger.

methods.name: List[Dict] _enforce_monotonic_nonoverlap( subs: List[Dict], min_gap: float = 0.02, min_dur: float = 0.2, *, _collect_adjustments: Optional[List[Tuple[int, float, float, float, float]]] = None, )
methods.description: Adjusts subtitle timings to ensure monotonic, non-overlapping, with minimal gaps and durations.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int,float] _best_transcript_span_for_sub( sub_tokens: List[str], transcript: List[Dict], start_idx: int, max_span: int = 5, min_sim: float = 0.2, )
methods.description: Finds the best contiguous span in the transcript that maximizes token similarity to a subtitle.

methods.name: Tuple[float,float] _distribute_time_within_span( sub_text: str, span_text: str, span_start: float, span_end: float )
methods.description: Estimates a subtitle's start and end times within a transcript span proportionally to text length.

methods.name: List[Dict] align_subtitles_to_transcript( transcript: Union[List[Dict], Dict[str, Any]], subtitles: List[Dict], *, max_span: int = 5, min_similarity: float = 0.2, min_duration: float = 0.4, min_gap: float = 0.02, verbose: bool = False, logger: Optional[logging.Logger] = None, )
methods.description: Main public function to realign subtitle cues to a reference transcript, performing token-based greedy alignment, timing adjustments, and overlap cleanup.
